=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:862-879 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `round_cap_verdict_exempt=true` is set whenever `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_parse` accepts `rb_judge_verdict` and `checks_rollup` is not failure/error, without ever consulting `PR_RB_VERDICT_CHANGE` (the `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` change reason), so heads whose verdict was judged changed (`base_unknown`/`disabled`, `base` overlap, empty `merge_state_status`, or merge-state drift such as `blocked`→`dirty`/`behind`/`unknown`) also escape the round cap.
  WHY: Such heads are dispatched for 1-2h review rounds on every sweep tick with no cap, which is the unbounded loop the cap exists to stop (PR #9178: 81 rounds). This contradicts the issue's "The round cap still bounds that path" fail-open constraint and the in-code comment "anything else stays capped". 4 reviewers rated it MAJOR; gemini stated no severity.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:335-349 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert`, for a head without gate success, `ma_since` is the earlier of `ma_verdict_at` and `ma_gate_at`. The pending head-gate status is posted at push or review start, before the verdict, so the alert age is measured from the gate time rather than from the verdict.
  WHY: The alert fires early, often on the first tick after a fresh deferred verdict, and uses up the single `ai-review/merge-wait-alert` marker, so a later real stall raises no alert. This violates G3 ("has had a verdict for longer than a configurable time"), and the test `test_refreshed_verdict_keeps_the_wait_age_of_the_gate_status` locks the behaviour in. 4 reviewers rated it MAJOR; gemini stated no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Fail-open: when the verdict or the waiting state cannot be read, dispatch as today. The round cap still bounds that path."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml (`round_cap_verdict_exempt` computation), fed by the change reason from `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh through `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` in scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The exemption reads only `.rb_judge_verdict` and `.checks_rollup`, `PR_RB_VERDICT_CHANGE` is not checked or passed out of `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason`, `base_unknown`/`disabled` heads are exempted instead of capped, no test covers a `base_unknown` verdict head with 10 or more rounds staying capped, and `test_verdict_head_with_a_failing_rollup_stays_capped` covers only the rollup case.
- requirement: "A switch (default on) that restores today's behaviour when set to false."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, the `Review-blocked judge decision` step env (the step that runs scripts/review_rb_judge.sh)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk passes `VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED` to the judge step, and review_autofix.yml is not in `pr_changed_files.txt` or `last_run_changed_files.txt`. `rb_judge_record_verdict_wait` defaults an unset value to `true` (`scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2673-2675`; last_run diff lines 2657-2660), so with `false` the sweep and poller restore dispatches but the judge still makes the GraphQL/PR read and posts `ai-review/rb-judge-verdict`. The README and the agents fragment document this asymmetry. Reviewers rated it NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash skipped it because the file is outside the `files_touched` grant and was recorded as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED.
- requirement: "unless something relevant changed since that decision: the head, the lease (granted to this PR), the base (moved under files the PR touches), or the result of a required check." (G2)
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh::_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting (`checks` branch), the verdict status written by scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, and the callers scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh::review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::_stall_rb_judge_verdict_unchanged
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` treats only a changed merge state, or a current aggregate check state of failure/error, as a change. The verdict description (`decision=<d> wait=<w> base=<sha> ms=<state>`) records no per-check result, so a required check going pending→success or missing→present while the merge state stays `blocked` is reported as unchanged (the #9939 `ci/final (missing)` shape). No test exercises a per-required-check transition, and `test_judge_sets_the_wait_token_only_on_benign_deferrals` locks in the narrower semantics. Three reviewers rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT with confidence 3, noting that a re-run cannot change the outcome in the residual case and that `blocked`→`clean` is detected.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:lines 872-878 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `round_cap_verdict_exempt` exemption checks only that the verdict parses and that the rollup is not failure/error. It never uses `PR_RB_VERDICT_CHANGE`, which is not passed out of `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason`, so `base_unknown` (`_pr_base_freshness` returns `disabled` or `unknown`, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1490-1497, 1526-1530), `base` overlap, and merge-state `checks` changes all escape the cap.
  WHY: With `MERGE_BASE_FRESHNESS_ENABLED=false` or a failing compare, every base move dispatches the head with no cap, which is the unbounded loop from PR #9178 and breaks the fail-open "round cap still bounds that path" contract. Fix: export the change reason and exempt only `lease`/`auto_merge`, plus `checks` when the new merge state is `clean`/`has_hooks`/`unstable`.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:lines 335-343, 349 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert` uses the earlier of the verdict time and the head-gate time, and the gate status posted at push (scripts/review_head_gate.sh:125-131) almost always comes earlier.
  WHY: A verdict recorded at T0+7h alerts immediately and uses up the single marker, against G3. `test_refreshed_verdict_keeps_the_wait_age_of_the_gate_status` asserts this. Fix: keep the original verdict time across a base refresh, or use `ma_verdict_at` alone.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Fail-open: when the verdict or the waiting state cannot be read, dispatch as today. The round cap still bounds that path."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml (`round_cap_verdict_exempt`), fed by `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh via `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` in scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh
  Evidence of absence: The exemption reads only `.rb_judge_verdict`/`.checks_rollup` and no change reason is passed. There is no test for a `base_unknown` head with 10 or more rounds; `test_verdict_head_with_a_failing_rollup_stays_capped` covers only the rollup case.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "A switch (default on) that restores today's behaviour when set to false."
  Expected change site: env of the review-blocked judge step running scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml)
  Evidence of absence: `VERDICT_WAIT_DISPATCH_SKIP_ENABLED` is not passed and `rb_judge_record_verdict_wait` defaults it to `true`, so the judge still reads and posts `ai-review/rb-judge-verdict`. The README and agents fragment document this. The file is outside the plan grant.
- HARDENING (2 related items) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert` marker POST uses bare `gh api` instead of `gh_retry gh api` (a transient 5xx gives `outcome=marker_write_failed`); fix with the `ma_api` array pattern, about 3 lines. scripts/review_rb_judge.sh `rb_judge_record_verdict_wait` `@tsv` + `IFS=$'\t' read` collapses empty fields; fix by joining with `"\u001f"` and reading with `IFS=$'\x1f'`, about 2 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
